title: CharitySense API
shortdesc: Search, compare, and explain U.S. nonprofits using CharitySense IRS Form 990 data.
desc: CharitySense provides a no-auth GPT Action for U.S. nonprofit research based on IRS Form 990 data. Use it for donor-intent search, charity/EIN lookup, nonprofit comparison, financial metrics, governance review, ratings, beneficiary geography, and citation-ready CharitySense profile URLs. Agent-facing docs: https://data.charitysense.com/agents
author: mtweak
